productActor: 二丫头 (existing Grok Bot, same private conversation)

finding.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 取得并整理了真实公开 README（23189 字节、15 个二级标题）；已独立核对哈希与补充结果的 27 处逐行引文，并修正建议/强制等表述。补读覆盖为 Bot 自报，补充原始工具记录缺失；文件上传、PDF/OCR、缺页与 Skill 复用未测，不算整篇流程通过。
finding.en: Partial: Grok Bot retrieved and summarized a real public README (23,189 bytes, 15 H2 headings). Its hash and 27 line-specific follow-up excerpts were independently checked; recommendation/requirement wording was corrected. Follow-up coverage is Bot-reported and its original tool transcript is missing. Uploads, PDF/OCR, missing-page handling and Skill reuse remain untested; this is not a full workflow pass.

finding.zh: 未核验：当前工具清单显示 Gmail 已连接，但未读取真实邮件。用户已选择指定测试标签，等待完整标签名后只读最多 5 封；标签、草稿、发送与 Routine 均未测。
finding.en: Unverified: the current tool catalog reports Gmail connected, but no real email has been read. The user chose a test label; its exact name is pending before reading at most five messages. Labels, drafts, sending and Routines remain untested.

finding.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 对三个真实公开地址执行单次 HTTP 读取，结果为 200/200/预期 404；Gmail 页边界锚点与三个标题已复核。仅含请求与源码检查，未测浏览器点击、图片呈现、后台、修复或 Routine；负向对照不是线上故障。
finding.en: Partial: Grok Bot made one-time HTTP reads of three real public URLs, returning 200/200/expected 404. The Gmail boundary anchor and three headings were checked. Requests and source inspection only; browser clicks, image rendering, backends, repairs and Routines remain untested. The negative control is not a production fault.

finding.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Calendar 连接。需用户连接或提供可访问的测试日历并指定日期，再做小范围只读；不能据清单缺项断言账号全局未连接。
finding.en: Unverified: documentation review only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Calendar. The user needs to connect/provide an accessible test calendar and a date for a bounded read. Catalog absence does not establish global disconnection.

finding.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Slack 连接。需用户连接并指定测试工作区、频道和时间窗，再核对主消息、线程与覆盖；未发送消息或创建 Routine。
finding.en: Unverified: documentation review only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Slack. The user needs to connect and specify a test workspace, channel and time window before checking messages, threads and coverage. No messages or Routines were created.

finding.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 只读了本站真实公开 PR #3、当前 head 对应检查与评审，原始接口结果已复核；CI、评审和已合并状态分别记录。未测未合并 PR 的持续跟进、分页、Notion 写入、通知或 Routine；mergeable=null 保持未知。
finding.en: Partial: Grok Bot read real public PR #3, its current-head checks and reviews; original API results were reviewed. CI, review and merged state are separate. Continuous tracking of open PRs, pagination, Notion writes, notifications and Routines remain untested; mergeable=null remains unknown.

finding.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核退款状态与边界资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Stripe。后续需用户提供测试模式连接和具体测试对象；仅做只读核对，真实退款由人工接管，未执行资金操作。
finding.en: Unverified: refund-state and boundary documentation only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Stripe. A test-mode connection and specified test objects are needed for a later read-only check; real refunds require user takeover. No financial action occurred.

finding.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核评论可见性与写入边界资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Zendesk。需用户提供测试环境与指定工单后先只读；私密备注、公开回复、状态更改及 Routine 均未测。
finding.en: Unverified: comment visibility and write-boundary documentation only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Zendesk. A test environment and specified tickets are needed before a read-only run. Private notes, public replies, status changes and Routines remain untested.

finding.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 只读了真实官方商品入口与两份规格，原始响应哈希已核对。给定 AirPods 4 购买地址跳到 AirPods 5，原型号当前价格、运费、税费和配送未取得，没有沿用旧价或替换型号价格；未完成真实到手价比较。浏览器、跨店比价、Skill 与交易未测，补充原始工具记录缺失。
finding.en: Partial: Grok Bot read real official product/specification pages and response hashes were checked. The specified AirPods 4 purchase URL redirected to AirPods 5. Current prices, shipping, taxes and delivery for the requested models were not obtained; neither old prices nor another model’s prices were substituted. Delivered-price comparison is incomplete. Browser, cross-store comparisons, Skills and transactions remain untested; the follow-up original tool transcript is missing.

reviewFindings.zh: 文档首轮合并了多项结论却只配一处依据，并把“提交前可以”写成动作；补充结果拆项引用，27 处引文均与具体行匹配。
reviewFindings.en: The first document result combined clauses under incomplete evidence and overstated a recommendation. The follow-up split the clauses; all 27 excerpts match their cited lines.

reviewFindings.zh: 三个网站请求为 200/200/预期404；只证明给定地址的 HTTP/源码观察，不等于全站健康或定时通过。
reviewFindings.en: Website responses were 200/200/expected 404. This establishes scoped HTTP/source observations, not site-wide health or a successful scheduled run.

reviewFindings.zh: PR检查与其head SHA一致；合并、评审、CI分开。mergeable为空的原因不由本轮证据证明，保持未知。
reviewFindings.en: PR checks match its head SHA; merge state, review and CI are separate. The reason for null mergeable is not established by this evidence.

reviewFindings.zh: 商品入口跳转到不同型号，目标型号报价缺失。未把HTTP200、旧搜索缓存或新型号标价当成目标商品报价。
reviewFindings.en: The product URL redirected to another model; requested-model prices are missing. HTTP200, old search caches and another model’s prices were not substituted.

provenanceLimits: The first original transcript contains direct Shell/Read calls and no delegation calls in the available current-run excerpt. Long fields are truncated and packaging is outside that export.

The follow-up original tool transcript is missing. Its full-read coverage, direct-executor claims and catalog discovery remain Bot reports supported by files, not independently visible complete tool events.

Raw website/product pages and unrelated private conversation are retained only in local archives. Public outputs include hashes, scoped results and a tool-only first-run excerpt; no assistant analysis is published.
Independent Codex reads and offline artifact checks are labeled separately and never substitute for Grok Bot execution.
No synthetic practice/reference result was promoted to a real execution pass. No case in this batch is a full workflow pass.

nextUserAction.scope: At most five messages in the specified label; no links, attachments, read-state changes, labels, drafts, sending or recurring tasks. Keep message content private; publish only sanitized counts and scope.
